newsitem.title: HONG KONG: BOC members possible HK listing candidates - Lehman.
newsitem.headline: BOC members possible HK listing candidates - Lehman.

text.p: Members of the Bank of China Group are possible listing candidates in Hong Kong this year, Lehman Brothers Asia said on Thursday.

"In my view, one or perhaps more members of the Bank of China Group are suitable candidates for new listing in the near future," the securities firm's senior regional banking analyst Raymond Lee told a news conference.
"We have a very strong representation from the Bank of China Group in Hong Kong. The performance has been as good as the industry if not better," he said.
The group has 13 member banks in Hong Kong, which posted profit growth of 21 percent in 1996, he noted.

That was in line with net profit growth of 21 percent for all banks in Hong Kong last year, and growth of 11 percent of all local banks excluding HSBC Holdings Plc, which has substantial overseas operations, he said.

The Bank of China Group, China's international banking arm, grabbed significant market share in 1996, making up 25 percent of total deposits, 20 percent of total loans and more than 10 percent of total mortgage lending in the territory, Lee said.
"We believe there could well be room for new listings coming to the banking sector," he added.
